summary: Adds a refresh icon button on the Accounts page that POSTs to new /accounts/sync_all, which queues a sync of all of the logged-in user's family accounts (incl. linked bank connections) and redirects with 'Syncing accounts...'; button disabled while a sync is running.

statements.why: Route is POST, behind ApplicationController's Authentication concern, scoped to Current.family (accounts_controller.rb:66); Syncable#sync_later dedupes in-flight syncs. Nothing an owner must worry about.

statements.text: + New server code that accepts requests. /accounts/sync_all
statements.why: New POST collection route + AccountsController#sync_all. Doesn't say what it does (sync all accounts) or that it needs login, but not false.
True but says nothing about the new refresh button.
